hero.title: Learn Flutter, one widget at a time.
hero.subtitle: Detailed write-ups, real code samples, and links to the official docs to really understand how to build apps with Flutter.

features.title: Why FlutterLearn?
features.interactiveText: Every widget page comes with real Dart code snippets, ready to copy into your own project.

features.bilingualText: The interface is available in French, English, and Arabic — learn in whichever language suits you.

about.title: About FlutterLearn
about.mission: FlutterLearn is a free, open-source site for learning Flutter and Dart step by step, with short write-ups, real code, and links to the official docs — no unnecessary jargon.
about.contactText: This project is meant to grow with its readers. Feel free to suggest new lessons.
